create_tesseract_ocr_model: create a TesseractOcrModel instance with enabled flag, artifacts path, options, and accelerator options
run_ocr_on_pages: run OCR on a batch of pages using TesseractOcrModel to extract text cells with bounding boxes and confidence scores
detect_orientation_script: detect document orientation and script using OSD reader for automatic language detection in OCR
extract_text_cells: extract text cells from OCR bounding boxes with coordinates, text content, and confidence values
post_process_ocr_cells: post-process extracted OCR text cells and attach them to the page for downstream document conversion
